{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Remove QA orders
df = df[df['revenue'] != 999999.99]

# Remove refunded orders
df = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Exclude rows where customer_age == -1 (sentinel for missing data)
df = df[df['customer_age'] != -1]

# Now compute mean age of customers who converted (converted == 1)
mean_age_converted = df[df['converted'] == 1]['customer_age'].mean()

print(f'Mean age of customers who converted: {mean_age_converted}')"}
